pages.raw_title: Core Lab: Leaders in Reservoir Optimization Solutions
pages.raw_meta: For 90 years, Core Lab has provided advanced core and fluid analysis, production optimization solutions, and expert consulting to the petroleum industry.
raw_blocks: Trusted by the World’s Leading Energy Companies for 90 Years
Engineered to unlock higher reservoir connectivity, improve breakdown performance, and faster stage execution.
Developing best-in-class tools to maximize results for the world’s leading energy companies.
Core Predict™ – AI Analog Data Search
Core Predict is an artificial intelligence tool that analyzes thin section images and searches our global rock catalog for measured petrophysical and geological analog data.

Core Lab’s Saybolt team provides independent quantity and quality inspection of all types of refined products drawn from vessels, tanks, barges, and other bulk storage facilities to help with loss control.
Tracer diagnostics provide operators long term, data-driven insights to optimize well spacing and enhance overall field development strategies.
3AB™ – Process Driven A/B Testing
Field trials, lab testing, and data analytics combine to de-risk decision making, creating a statistically relevant data set in just two to three wells.
Core Lab is the premiere partner for energy companies for Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) subsurface characterization.
Now into its 40th year, the consortium focuses on investigating methods to optimize recovery from hydraulically fractured oil and gas wells.
Since 1936, Core Lab has delivered innovative technologies and data-driven insights that help clients derisk decisions across complex energy environments around the world.
Beyond Today’s Wells: Exploring the Future of Resource Recovery
Supporting Innovation and Knowledge Sharing Across the Energy Industry
The leading provider of proprietary and patented reservoir description and production enhancement services and products.

pages.raw_title: About Core Lab - 90 Years of Petroleum Industry Innovation
pages.raw_meta: Explore Core Lab’s legacy of technical excellence, advanced analytical services, and industry-leading solutions for optimizing reservoir performance.
raw_blocks: Established in 1936, Core Lab has built a strong global reputation for delivering proprietary and patented reservoir description and production enhancement services. We develop innovative, tailored solutions and advanced products that optimize reservoir performance, maximize hydrocarbon recovery, and meet the evolving needs of the oil and gas industry.
Setting a standard of excellence, our five Core Values represent and establish the way we treat each other and conduct our business. They simply define “how we do things around here”.
We provide a work environment where employees are empowered to manage their work safely and responsibly.
We behave consistently, acting in accordance with moral, ethical, and professional guidelines.
We build and maintain the highest levels of customer service and satisfaction internally and externally.
We promote an atmosphere of openness, respect, and dignity, producing confidence in our intentions.
We invest in our people to build a stronger workforce ready and willing to get the right results the right way, every time.
Strong corporate governance is the cornerstone of our success. This begins with solid leadership.
Our commitment to sustainability includes careful consideration of social and environmental impacts and dedication to the highest standards of governance.
We continue to build and maintain a workforce of talented and diverse individuals.
